summary: C1 Explore review approved. The Explore artifact now defines a scoped formal-fact Reader, atomic Run persistence, and ResultRef adapter consistent with frozen A1/B1 and integration contracts. It preserves terminal immutability with staging creation and exclusive fs.link completion publication; uses a non-self-referential, validated physical result schema; keeps execution status single-source; and leaves Policy, diagnostic CLI, OpenSpec CLI integration, Full Test, and Git automation out of scope. The revision also reconciles the only terminal-result write path and the writeRunResult object API across Q5, Q7, acceptance criteria, conclusions, and review points.

resolvedFindings.resolution: Resolved by revision 052: writeRunResult receives a RunResultFile object and alone validates, serializes, and exclusively publishes it; Q7 adapter only constructs the object and derives references on read.
